warnings: DOOR AND WINDOW MARKS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT LISTED FROM THIS SHEET. The plan tags every opening with a circled ป-number (ประตู, door) or a diamond น-number (หน้าต่าง, window), printed at about 10 px per glyph on this scan. Reading a ป3 as ป8 would silently create a phantom mark, which §10's SI-versus-S1 warning exists to prevent. A-14 and A-15 (หน้า15, หน้า16) are the แบบขยายประตู-หน้าต่าง schedules and are the authoritative source for the mark list and every opening's size; the marks are recorded there. What IS recorded here is what only this sheet gives - room names, levels, floor-finish codes and the construction notes. A later pass on the full-size sheet should add the per-opening positions.
THE MARK PREFIXES ARE THAI ON THIS SET - ป for doors and น for windows, not the D1/W1 of houses 01-05. Recorded as printed per §0.3; do not normalise them to D/W.

FLOOR-FINISH CODES ARE THE พ SERIES defined on A-03 (พ1 tile 12x12, พ2 tile 8x8, พ3 tile 8x8 with washed gravel, พ4 smooth cement, พ5 tile with washed sand, พ6 hardwood 1x4). The boxed tags on this plan assign them per room and are recorded on each room as floor_finish. Where a room carries more than one tag the dominant one is recorded and the room is left at its stated confidence.

THE GRID CHAINS ON THIS SHEET MATCH THE STRUCTURAL MASTER EXACTLY - 3.50/2.20/3.00 = 8.70 across, 2.00/0.80/4.00/3.00/1.60 = 11.40 down, plus the same 1.80 carport overhang beyond grid 4 and the 1.00 above ง'. That is a third independent confirmation of the master after S-01 and S-02.

SUB-CHAINS PRINTED ON THIS SHEET ONLY (0.40/1.40, 0.80/0.40 across the top; 1.30, 0.70/0.50, 1.20, 1.00, 0.80/0.50/0.65, 0.65/0.35, 0.50 down the side) dimension wall and opening positions, not structural lines. None was used to add a grid line - no beam lands on any of them.
The เฉลียง floor is drawn as a tile grid and the จอดรถ floor as a separate slab with a 0.10 m gravel-filled joint all the way round, which matches the GS slab-on-grade recorded on S-01.

OPENING VOCABULARY RESOLVED ON A-14/A-15 (หน้า15, หน้า16). This file records no ป/น marks because the glyphs are unreadable at this scan's resolution. The schedules give the full closed list - eight door types ป1-ป8 and nine window types น1-น9, seventeen marks - so any later pass adding positions to this sheet has a fixed vocabulary to match against and cannot invent a mark. What is still missing is only WHICH type sits in WHICH opening on this drawing.
